instructions.purpose: Store one explicit durable fact as a new live memory.

tool.name: remember-memory
tool.description: Creates a new fact for the current chat without reviving forgotten rows.

usage_rules.rule: Always call search-memory first for the same subject.
Use one complete sentence with one durable claim and an explicit subject.
Copy into sourceMessage the exact user transcript message that stated the fact. Never use the later remember command or an assistant message as its source.
If the same fact is already live, report that it is already remembered and do not call this tool.
Pass every clearly replaced live fact ID in supersedesFactIds, or an empty list when none are replaced.
If the user's intended fact is ambiguous, return the ambiguity to Main so Main can ask for clarification.
Remembering creates a new fact. Never claim that a forgotten row was restored.

example.context: The user explicitly said "My bicycle is named Comet", and search-memory finds no live bicycle-name fact.

toolCall.fact: The user's bicycle is named Comet.
